description: Conformant variants for the advanced tier of the test-writing exercise. Each entry rewrites one snippet of a :core source file WITHOUT changing what the algebra decides; ./gradlew generateVariants turns it into a module that compiles the real :core with that one file swapped, and ./gradlew verifyVariants runs your suite against each. A suite that pins only the contract stays green on all of them, so a failure is reported as a false alarm together with the tests to relax. Entries carry no description on purpose — saying which behaviour each one frees would tell you which tests to drop before you have found out for yourself. What makes these legal is the contract addendum for this tier, and nothing else. Patterns match whole `override` lines, since the KDoc above them quotes the same expression.
